title: Concept: Werkzeug interactive debugger page disclosed
description: A response carries the Werkzeug debugger console page. Debug mode is the most common Flask production mistake: the interactive console exposes the stack, local variables and environment of the failing request, and the PIN that guards it has been bypassed in public research for years.
applicability: Flask and Werkzeug deployments reachable from untrusted networks.
risk: Source, locals and an interactive console disclosed to requesters; MEDIUM severity.
